definitions.explanation: Clothing worn under outer garments, next to the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{下着|したぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
{下着|したぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{洗|あら}います→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
examples.english: I wash my underwear every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下着|したぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いきます→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many pairs of underwear are you taking on the trip?

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧{下着|したぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}げます→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: In winter, wearing warm underwear can help protect against the cold.

notes:
{下着|したぎ} is a general term for underwear, covering all types of undergarments.

TYPES OF UNDERWEAR:
- ⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧: underpants, briefs
- ⟦ブラジャー→ブラジャー：08990_burajaa⟧: bra
- ⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: undershirt
- ⟦{肌着|はだぎ}→肌着：00080_hadagi⟧: underwear worn next to skin

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧: jacket, outer garment
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes (general)
- ⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧: change of clothes

Note: {下着|したぎ} is a compound of ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (under) + {着|ぎ} (wearing/clothes).
